  "plan": "Write scrape.py using requests + BeautifulSoup. Parse each div.book, strip prefixes. Compute stats for the report. Then run it and verify outputs.",
  "commands": [
    {
      "keystrokes": "cat > /app/scrape.py << 'EOF'
import re
import requests
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup
import pandas as pd

URL = "http://server:8000"

def main():
    resp = requests.get(URL, timeout=30)
    resp.raise_for_status()
    soup = BeautifulSoup(resp.text, "html.parser")

    books = []
    for book in soup.find_all("div", class_="book"):
        title_el = book.find("div", class_="book-title")
        author_el = book.find("div", class_="book-author")
        year_el = book.find("span", class_="book-year")
        rating_el = book.find("span", class_="book-rating")
        price_el = book.find("span", class_="book-price")

        title = title_el.get_text(strip=True) if title_el else ""
        author = ""
        if author_el:
            author = re.sub(r"^by\s+", "", author_el.get_text(strip=True))
        year = ""
        if year_el:
            m = re.search(r"(\d{4})", year_el.get_text())
            year = int(m.group(1)) if m else None
        rating = None
        if rating_el:
            m = re.search(r"([\d.]+)/\s*5", rating_el.get_text())
            rating = float(m.group(1)) if m else None
        price = None
        if price_el:
            m = re.search(r"\$?\s*([\d.]+)", price_el.get_text())
            price = float(m.group(1)) if m else None

        books.append({
            "title": title,
            "author": author,
            "year": year,
            "rating": rating,
            "price": price,
        })

    df = pd.DataFrame(books, columns=["title", "author", "year", "rating", "price"])
    df.to_csv("books.csv", index=False)

    total = len(df)
    avg_price = df["price"].mean()
    highest = df.loc[df["rating"].idxmax()]

    lines = []
    lines.append("Book Store Scraping Summary Report")
    lines.append("=" * 40)
    lines.append(f"Total number of books scraped: {total}")
    lines.append(f"Average book price: ${avg_price:.2f}")
    lines.append(f"Highest rated book: {highest['title']} (Rating: {highest['rating']}/5, by {highest['author']})")

    with open("report.txt", "w") as f:
        f.write("\n".join(lines) + "\n")

    print("\n".join(lines))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
EOF
",
      "duration": 0.1
    },
    {
      "keystrokes": "cd /app && python3 scrape.py
",
      "duration": 3.0
    }
  ]
}

import re
import requests
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup
import pandas as pd

URL = "http://server:8000"

def main():
    resp = requests.get(URL, timeout=30)
    resp.raise_for_status()
    soup = BeautifulSoup(resp.text, "html.parser")

    books = []
    for book in soup.find_all("div", class_="book"):
        title_el = book.find("div", class_="book-title")
        author_el = book.find("div", class_="book-author")
        year_el = book.find("span", class_="book-year")
        rating_el = book.find("span", class_="book-rating")
        price_el = book.find("span", class_="book-price")

        title = title_el.get_text(strip=True) if title_el else ""
        author = ""
        if author_el:
            author = re.sub(r"^by\s+", "", author_el.get_text(strip=True))
        year = ""
        if year_el:
            m = re.search(r"(\d{4})", year_el.get_text())
            year = int(m.group(1)) if m else None
        rating = None
        if rating_el:
            m = re.search(r"([\d.]+)/\s*5", rating_el.get_text())
            rating = float(m.group(1)) if m else None
        price = None
        if price_el:
            m = re.search(r"\$?\s*([\d.]+)", price_el.get_text())
            price = float(m.group(1)) if m else None

        books.append({
            "title": title,
            "author": author,
            "year": year,
            "rating": rating,
            "price": price,
        })

    df = pd.DataFrame(books, columns=["title", "author", "year", "rating", "price"])
    df.to_csv("books.csv", index=False)

    total = len(df)
    avg_price = df["price"].mean()
    highest = df.loc[df["rating"].idxmax()]

    lines = []
    lines.append("Book Store Scraping Summary Report")
    lines.append("=" * 40)
    lines.append(f"Total number of books scraped: {total}")
    lines.append(f"Average book price: ${avg_price:.2f}")
    lines.append(f"Highest rated book: {highest['title']} (Rating: {highest['rating']}/5, by {highest['author']})")

    with open("report.txt", "w") as f:
        f.write("\n".join(lines) + "\n")

    print("\n".join(lines))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
EOF
